description: Capability set for the expanded desktop window. App-registered commands remain behind their native feature, path, membership, and tenant checks. Projects reads through get_local_projects and persists status through set_local_project_status and set_local_story_passes; native wrappers authorize the canonical company scope before reads or writes. Files and Knowledge accept HQ-relative paths only: native commands canonicalize them, reject cross-company resolution, refresh live membership, cap preview bytes, and retain absolute paths inside Rust for preview, reveal, and file-scoped Claude dispatch. Wildcard asset-protocol access and renderer Image.fromPath are intentionally unavailable.
